title: CmdPal: Bookmark {placeholder} field retains last-entered value on every subsequent open
author: tbertran
summary: Command Palette bookmark placeholder controls are cached with the bookmark command and retain StringParameterRun values after a successful launch. A cross-architecture UI Automation reproduction now confirms the value persists only within the Command Palette session and resets after restart.

status.label: Focused design ready
status.detail: The deterministic reproduction, source analysis, and new x64/ARM64 UI Automation evidence match current main.

next_action.label: Reproduce placeholder session retention
next_action.reason: The cross-architecture automation provides a maintainer-ready path to verify the lifecycle boundary before implementing the reset.

judgment.rationale: The current object lifetime and missing reset are directly visible in source.
evidence: The form starts empty only on first open, then reuses the last value.
The issue identifies the involved classes.
Current main stores StringParameterRun instances on a long-lived page.
LaunchWithCurrentValues dismisses after success without clearing runs.
An independent UI Automation reproduction passed its controls on x64 and ARM64 and showed the submitted value on the next open.
Restarting Command Palette resets the field, confirming that the value is session-cached rather than persisted to bookmarks.json.
judgment.recommended_action: Design and test reset on successful launch or page activation; do not approve until lifecycle and failure semantics are finalized.

issue_context.summary: Dynamic bookmark fields persist for the session although users expect a fresh parameter form for each invocation.
known_information: A `{placeholder}` bookmark starts empty on first open.
Later opens are prefilled with the last submitted value.
An independent UI Automation run reproduced identical session-only retention on x64 and ARM64.
The field is empty after restarting Command Palette, and the value is not persisted to bookmarks.json.
No assignee, duplicate, or linked fix exists.
inferences: Clearing only after successful launch likely preserves failed input for correction.
Rebuilding the command on every activation may be broader than necessary.
issue_context.analysis: The source trace and cross-architecture automated reproduction now independently confirm the session-lifetime state leak, so more reporter diagnostics would not change triage; reset timing, accessibility targeting, and regression tests are the remaining work.
initial_investigation: BookmarkListItem.cs creates and retains one BookmarkPlaceholderPage as the command.
BuildParameterRuns creates StringParameterRun objects once in the constructor.
LaunchWithCurrentValues reads Text and dismisses without reset.
The parameter-page implementation landed in #47886; no later reset fix appears.
The existing CmdPal UI-test harness locates controls by AutomationId, while the placeholder TextBox currently has neither x:Name nor AutomationProperties.AutomationId.

reproduce.version_requirements: PowerToys 0.101.2362 or a current main build.
prerequisites: Create a bookmark containing one `{placeholder}` field.
Keep Command Palette running during the first comparison.
steps: Open the bookmark and confirm the field starts empty.
Enter a unique value and launch successfully.
Reopen the bookmark without restarting Command Palette.
Record whether the prior value remains.
Restart Command Palette and reopen the bookmark.
Repeat on x64 and ARM64 when available.
reproduce.expected_result: Each new invocation should start with an empty placeholder field.
setup_requirements: Record whether failed launches intentionally retain input for correction.
